DISP-001.description: The driver took PIE instead of ECP and my fare was higher than it should be. I want the extra charge refunded.

DISP-002.description: I was at the pickup point at Tiong Bahru Plaza on time but the driver never showed up. I waited 10 minutes at the lobby and couldn't find the car. The app charged me a $5.00 cancellation fee for a 'no-show' which is completely unfair — I was there, the driver was not. I want the charge reversed immediately.

DISP-003.description: The rider vomited in my back seat. I need $100 for cleaning.
